title: MiniMax-H3
description: Serverless worker for MiniMax-H3 — a 33B omni-modal video+audio generation model (text/image -> video + stereo audio), served via ComfyUI and loaded from RunPod's endpoint model cache (cache-first). Uses the Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3 single-file build. NOTE: the MiniMax H3 Community License applies (territory & usage restrictions; outputs may not be used to train other models).

input.name: Model
input.description: Hugging Face repo to load from the endpoint model cache. Defaults to the Comfy-Org single-file build.

input.name: Model variant
input.description: Which MiniMax-H3 task variant to serve.

input.name: Precision
input.description: Weight quantization. int8_convrot is preferred on cu130; fp8_scaled and bf16 are fallbacks.

input.name: ComfyUI extra args
input.description: Extra CLI args passed to ComfyUI main.py.

input.name: Hugging Face token
input.description: Only needed if the model is gated for your account.
